macros.name: AdvisorName
macros.doc: \AdvisorName{⟨supervisors’ formal title⟩} gets the string that qualifies the supervisor(s); the default string is “Relatore:” or “Relatori:” for the plural; in another language this command is used to define the string, say, “Supervisors:” if the thesis has been supervised by more than one person.

macros.name: AnnoAccademico
macros.doc: \AnnoAccademico{⟨substitute string for academic year⟩} Sets a different string in place of the default “Anno Accademico” one.

macros.name: ateneo
macros.doc: \scuoladidottorato gets the name of the PhD School; \ateneo gets the generic name of the university; \nomeateneo gets the proper name of the university.

macros.name: candidato
macros.doc: \candidato{⟨candidate’ name (man)⟩} gets the name and surname of an author (M).

macros.name: CoAdvisorName
macros.doc: \CoAdvisorName{⟨co-supervisors’ formal title⟩} gets the string that qualifies the co-supervisor(s); the default string is “Correlatore:” or “Correlatori:” in the plural; this command may be used to define the string, say, “Corapporteur:” in a French Projet de fin d’études.

macros.name: logosede
macros.doc: \logosede{⟨logo file name⟩} specifies the name of the file or the files that contain the university logos; no default is defined; rather a warning message is issued if no name is given or the file is missing, but typesetting goes on without the inclusion of any logo.

macros.name: materia
macros.doc: \materia{⟨discipline⟩} or the alias \Materia{⟨discipline⟩} get the name of the discipline the thesis deals with.

macros.name: Materia
macros.doc: \materia{⟨discipline⟩} or the alias \Materia{⟨discipline⟩} get the name of the discipline the thesis deals with.

macros.name: monografia
macros.doc: \monografia{⟨title⟩} sets the bachelor’s report style and retrieves its title; the command\titolo that is not available for this purpose with the standard module TOPfront, is available when the specific module has been loaded by means of the monografia or triennale options.

macros.name: NomeAnnoAccademico
macros.doc: \NomeAnnoAccademico{⟨academic year name⟩} defines the infix string that stands for “Academic year”.

macros.name: NomeAteneo
macros.doc: \NomeAteneo{⟨University name⟩} sets the proper name of a specific university; it will be typeset in suitable uppercase type under the generic name of the university; if this command is not used, no name gets typeset in the title page.

macros.name: relatore
macros.doc: \relatore{⟨supervisor name⟩} gets the name of the thesis principal supervisor.

macros.name: retrofrontespizio
macros.doc: \retrofrontespizio{⟨copyright page text⟩} with its argument, made up of one or more paragraphs, defines what should be printed on the verso of the title page, generally named “copyright page”; if this command is specified with an empty text or if it is not used at all, no copyright page is assumed.

macros.name: secondacandidata
macros.doc: \secondacandidata⟨second candidate’s name (woman)⟩ gets the name and surname of the second W author.

macros.name: secondocandidato
macros.doc: \secondocandidato{⟨second candidate’s name (man)⟩} gets the name and surname of the second M author.

macros.name: secondorelatore
macros.doc: \secondorelatore{⟨second supervisor’s name⟩} gets the name of the second supervisor if any.

macros.name: sedutadilaurea
macros.doc: \sedutadilaurea{⟨thsis defense date⟩} gets the date of the final exam, or presentation, or defence of the thesis; if this date is omitted the default date is the current month and year in the current language (generally Italian).

macros.name: setlogodistance
macros.doc: \setlogodistance{⟨distance⟩} sets the distance between adjacent university logos, if more than one are used.

macros.name: sottotitolo
macros.doc: \sottotitolo{⟨subtitle⟩} gets the thesis subtitle if any.

macros.name: struttura
macros.doc: \struttura[⟨ordinal number⟩]{⟨Structure name⟩} sets the name of the university entity that supervises the development of the degree course; it may be a “faculty”, a “department”, a “school”, it depends from the specific university.

macros.name: terzocandidato
macros.doc: \terzocandidato{⟨third candidate’s name (man)⟩} gets the name and surname of the third M author.

macros.name: terzorelatore
macros.doc: \terzorelatore{⟨third supervisor’s name⟩} gets the name of the third supervisor, if any; it is assumed that the number of supervisors never exceeds three; in case follow one of the tricks exemplified in the example file toptesi-example.tex in order to manage such situation.

macros.name: titolo
macros.doc: \titolo[⟨shorttitle⟩]{⟨title⟩} gets the master or PhD thesis title and an optional thesis short title.

envs.name: ThesisTitlePage
envs.doc: ThesisTitlePage is the environment within which the title page data are specified; some data are preset to default values; some data receive global definitions so that they remain available for setting up some metadata.
